_comment: Deterministic, case-insensitive, word-boundary replacements applied to every transcript. Put ONLY unambiguous garbles here, never a spelling that is also a legitimate word in your own speech: the replacement has no context to fall back on. Ambiguous fixes belong to the optional LLM polish pass instead.
_phrases_comment: Say a trigger phrase, get this saved block of text pasted verbatim instead. A sibling of "replacements", not merged into it: this text is never sent through the optional LLM polish or prompt-optimizer passes, and reaches the clipboard exactly as written, so it is the right place for standard boilerplate you want word-for-word, never for text you want cleaned up. Values may span multiple lines. Matching is case-insensitive and whole-phrase; saying the trigger alone (with whisper's own trailing period) still expands cleanly.

phrases.standard engagement caveat: This engagement is provided on our standard consulting terms and does not constitute financial advice.
